name: riel-public-website
description: Public marketing site for riel (riel.social). Plain static HTML/CSS/JS served from public/ by Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.validate: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.deploy:preview: wrangler pages deploy public --project-name riel-public-website --branch "$(git branch --show-current)"
scripts.deploy: wrangler pages deploy public --project-name riel-public-website --branch main
